name: Johan Sverdrup power-from-shore (Equinor), North Sea
description: field producing since Oct 2019 entirely on hydropower from shore; CO2 emissions 0.67 kg/bbl vs about 9 kg/bbl NCS average; launch estimate 460,000 t CO2/yr avoided, Equinor now states more than 620,000 t/yr

sources.note: Equinor electrification page (0.67 kg vs ~9 kg average; started 2019); Equinor news 9 Oct 2018 (460,000 t/yr estimate); Equinor Johan Sverdrup page (more than 620,000 t/yr); read 2026-10-28
